sql: with t as (select right(regexp_replace(coalesce(test_mode_number,''),'\D','','g'), 8) n from public.ai_agent_settings where company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'), c as (select c.id from public.wapi_conversations c, t where c.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and t.n <> '' and c.remote_jid like '%' || t.n || '@%' and c.bot_step = 'human_takeover') select to_char(m.timestamp at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'HH24:MI:SS') as hora, m.from_me, m.message_type, m.metadata->>'source' as src, left(replace(coalesce(m.content,''), E'\n', ' '), 90) as texto from public.wapi_messages m join c on c.id = m.conversation_id where m.timestamp > now() - interval '5 hours' order by m.timestamp
